records.source: This movie's hilarious! How do they come up with this stuff?$h
records.translation: Nakakatawa talaga ang pelikulang ito! Paano nila naiisip ang mga ganitong bagay?$h

records.source: Sam can't contain his laughter!
records.translation: Hindi mapigil ni Sam ang pagtawa!

records.source: *psst*... Don't tell anyone, but I wear the same type of socks as Wumbus.
records.translation: *psst*... Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman, pero kapareho ng kay Wumbus ang uri ng medyas ko.

records.source: So you like scary movies, huh? I'm a little surprised!
records.translation: Mahilig ka pala sa nakakatakot na pelikula, ha? Medyo nagulat ako!

records.source: That was pretty good! I'm usually not scared by movies, but that one got to me a little... I don't think I'll take Vincent to see this.
records.translation: Maganda naman iyon! Karaniwan ay hindi ako natatakot sa mga pelikula, pero medyo tinablan ako niyon... Sa palagay ko ay hindi ko isasama si Vincent upang mapanood ito.

records.source: Hey, thanks for inviting me, @... It's really great that we have a movie theater in town now.
records.translation: Hoy, salamat sa pag-imbita sa akin, @... Napakagandang mayroon na tayong sinehan sa bayan.

records.source: That wasn't bad! I might have to take Vincent to see this.
records.translation: Hindi naman iyon masama! Baka isama ko si Vincent upang mapanood ito.

records.source: It's an old movie with lots of talking, right? Hmm... $s
records.translation: Lumang pelikula itong puro usapan, hindi ba? Hmm... $s

records.source: Huh? Oh! Yeah... The movie's... interesting...$10
records.translation: Huh? Oh! Oo... Ang pelikula ay... kawili-wili...$10

records.source: Sam is playing his handheld video game system.
records.translation: Naglalaro si Sam sa kaniyang nabibitbit na konsola.

records.source: Yeah... Uh... That one character was interesting... And, um... heh...$10
records.translation: Oo... Uh... Kawili-wili ang isang tauhang iyon... At, um... heh...$10

records.source: I'm so excited! My mom said I can have candy, too!$h
records.translation: Sabik na sabik ako! Sabi ni Nanay, maaari rin akong kumain ng kendi!$h

records.source: Vincent is having a blast!
records.translation: Sobrang saya ni Vincent!

records.source: That was so fun! I wanna go see it again!$h
records.translation: Sobrang saya niyon! Gusto ko iyong panoorin ulit!$h

records.source: B... But... This movie is for grown-ups, isn't it?$s
records.translation: P... Pero... Para sa matatanda ang pelikulang ito, hindi ba?$s

records.source: Vincent is fidgeting in his seat.
records.translation: Hindi mapakali si Vincent sa kaniyang upuan.

records.source: That was boring... I didn't understand anything.$s
records.translation: Nakababagot iyon... Wala akong naintindihan.$s

records.source: Thanks for inviting me to the movies, @. It's not easy to adjust back into the civilian lifestyle, but you've helped me feel really welcome.
records.translation: Salamat sa pag-imbita sa akin sa sinehan, @. Hindi madaling masanay muli sa buhay ng isang sibilyan, pero tinulungan mo akong maramdamang tanggap ako rito.

records.source: This is great... it reminds me of simpler times...$h
records.translation: Napakaganda nito... ipinaaalala nito sa akin ang mas payak na mga panahon...$h

records.source: Kent has a rare smile on his face.
records.translation: May pambihirang ngiti sa mukha ni Kent.

records.source: That was fun. When you're engrossed in a movie, all your cares and worries disappear.
records.translation: Masaya iyon. Kapag tutok na tutok ka sa isang pelikula, naglalaho ang lahat ng alalahanin mo.

records.source: I'm not sure about this movie...
records.translation: Hindi ako tiyak sa pelikulang ito...

records.source: Kent is breaking out into a cold sweat...
records.translation: Pinagpapawisan ng malamig si Kent...

records.source: That was challenging for me. Still, I appreciate you inviting me to this.
records.translation: Mahirap iyon para sa akin. Gayunman, pinahahalagahan kong inimbitahan mo ako.

records.source: This movie's supposed to be a romance, right? *sigh*$s
records.translation: Pelikulang romantiko raw ito, hindi ba? *buntong-hininga*$s

records.source: Why would she like THAT guy? Totally unrealistic if you ask me...$3
records.translation: Bakit niya magugustuhan ang lalaking IYON? Talagang hindi kapani-paniwala kung ako ang tatanungin...$3

records.source: Clint is scowling.
records.translation: Nakasimangot si Clint.

records.source: That movie was depressing...$s
records.translation: Nakapanlulumo ang pelikulang iyon...$s

records.source: I guess it's 'guys night', huh? Does that mean I have to buy my own snacks?^Oh... A... Are we on a date, then?$4
records.translation: Sa palagay ko ay 'gabi ng mga lalaki' ito, ha? Ibig bang sabihin, ako ang bibili ng sarili kong meryenda?^Oh... D... Date ba natin ito?$4

records.source: It's just... *hic*... Joja Cola.$h^*whispers*...If you're, um... tired... you can put your head on my... my shoulder. Heh... or not!$4
records.translation: Ito ay... *sinok*... Joja Cola lang.$h^*bulong*...Kung, um... pagod ka... maaari mong ipatong ang ulo mo sa... sa balikat ko. Heh... o huwag na!$4
